transformations.source:
INPUT Score

    IF Score >= 70 THEN
        OUTPUT "Distinction"
    ELSE IF Score >= 50 THEN
        OUTPUT "Merit"
    ELSE IF Score >= 40 THEN
        OUTPUT "Pass"
    ELSE
        OUTPUT "Fail"
    ENDIF
END
